Definition: from G2819; to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege):--obtain an inheritance.
BiblicalUsage: Kleroo means to allot, to assign a portion by lot. Ephesians 1:11 says, in whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ephesians 1:11 means the lot is not chance: it is the counsel of God's own will, and the inheritance is assigned before we ever ask for it.
